metadata.case_name: TSE TSZ KEUNG POCO v. CHAN YICK CHUN AND ANOTHER

source: According to Dr. Kong, the Plaintiff suffered neck sprain as a result of this accident.
I am satisfied that the accident did occur in manner stated by the Plaintiff and that the Plaintiff did suffer “neck sprain” as a result.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

source: The Plaintiff had a prior traffic accident where he also suffered neck sprain injury and he also had pre-existing cervical spondylosis.

injuries.description: degenerative changes mainly at C5/6 with mild thecal sac compression; narrowed disc space C5/6 with anterior and posterior bony spurs
source: According to Dr. Kong, the MRI report of cervical spine prepared by Dr. Lee Yat Wing of Department of Radiology of Caritas Medical Centre dated 29 August 2007 showed degenerative changes mainly at C5/6 level where mild thecal sac compression is noted.

Again X-ray of cervical spine dated 18 August 2009 showed decrease in cervical lordosis and mild degree of pre-existing degenerative changes. The disc space C5/6 is narrowed with anterior and posterior bony spurs. There is no abnormal soft tissue swelling.

manifestations.description: stiff neck and tenderness at back of neck
numbness over midline of CT and right upper border of trapezium muscle region
slightly reduced range of motions of the neck, especially in lateral flexion and rotation
mild discomfort and difficulty in driving when parking or when checking shoulders or rotating head; mild reduction in working efficiency

treatments_received: physiotherapy (around 19 sessions from 27 April 2006 to 5 September 2006)
follow-up consultations at Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Caritas Medical Centre

losses.description: Mild discomfort and difficulty in driving when parking or when checking shoulders or rotating head; mild reduction in working efficiency and reduced range of neck movement and intermittent numbness.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Kam Hoi v Dragages et Travaux Publics
comparable_cases.injury_description: 2nd plaintiff suffered dizziness after the accident; soft tissue sprain and contusion injury to her neck and low back (2nd plaintiff awarded HK$90,000).
